votes.quote: member jeffreys moved for the select board to commit $387,565 of arpa funds for the purpose of purchasing body camera upgrades for the police department ($45,000), power stretcher and loader ($74,000), replacement of 15 portable radios ($50,000), a stair chair ($23,000), gas powered cement mixer ($4,720), mini excavator ($72,500), trailer for the mini excavator ($14,700), a pickup truck with plow for the school department ($64,780.05), middle high school window safety film ($26,865), and a fence for the council on aging generator ($12,000). member moore seconded. the motion passed unanimously (5-0-0).
